metadata.description: Little Kids, Big Hearts explores what it means to have a big heart and how to grow one with episodes focused on feelings, friendship, and trying new things. Kids share their feelings and experiences, go on imaginary journeys to the Land of Qook-a-lackas, solve problems, and sing along to original songs in this social and emotional podcast for kids and families.
metadata.author: Sparkler Learning
